title: Multi-tenant SaaS
goal: Show tenant-scoped users, billing, roles, and feature configuration with crow's-foot cardinality.

rubric.must: Tenant visibly contains one or more User records.
Tenant visibly holds subscriptions and Subscription visibly produces invoices.
Role visibly assigns users and Tenant visibly configures feature flags.
Tenant, User, Role, Subscription, Invoice, and Feature Flag are visible with readable fields.
Tenant-related foreign-key fields are visibly shown in User, Subscription, and Feature Flag.
Relationship endpoints visibly use crow's-foot cardinality marks.

ideal.notes: Drafted by Codex from the source, the rubric and the erd exemplar, without seeing the engine's own output.

review.evidence: All six entities and their fields are visible and readable. The five labeled relationships match the source, show the intended crow’s-foot cardinalities, and connect traceably without material overlap or cropping.

items.evidence: TENANT contains USER, with exactly one tenant and one or more users indicated.
TENANT holds SUBSCRIPTION, and SUBSCRIPTION produces INVOICE; both relationships show one tenant/subscription to zero or more children.
ROLE assigns USER and TENANT configures FEATURE_FLAG, with the displayed cardinalities matching the source.
TENANT, USER, ROLE, SUBSCRIPTION, INVOICE, and FEATURE_FLAG are present with their listed fields legible.
USER shows tenant_id as FK, SUBSCRIPTION shows tenant_id as FK, and FEATURE_FLAG shows tenant_id as FK.
Relationship endpoints use bar, circle, and crow’s-foot marks, with a cardinality legend visible.
